pattern: a session whose file tools can't leave its folder delegates wiki work without trying the checkout
experience: Antigravity's file tools refuse any path outside its working folder, reads included; an agent given only the checkout's path reads it first, gets refused, and stalls or writes the note into the repository.
rule: Astrolabe wikis: if your file tools can't reach or write a wiki's folder, delegate_task with wiki set to its name.
